chunks: And (there was) in Moses when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Moses being sent to Pharaoh?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Dhariyat, this verse underscores the divine mandate of Prophet Moses (AS) by highlighting the 'clear proof' (sultan) granted against Pharaoh's tyranny, a concept Shia exegesis often links to the Ahl al-Bayt's enduring authority. The mention of Pharaoh serves as a paradigmatic example of the arrogant ruler who rejects truth despite evident signs, reinforcing the theme of divine justice in the face of oppression.
